data.name: Maktub
data.long_meaning: The Arabic word ‘Maktub’ means ‘written’ in the Arabic language. It is derived from the trilateral Arabic root ‘ktb’, which means ‘to write’. In the Islamic context, it is often used to refer to the idea that everything that happens in our lives is written in Allah’s book, or the Quran.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies the belief that everything that happens in life is predestined by Allah and is written in His book.
